subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration / SDK & function-calling fit
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration / SDK & function-calling fit

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of needs / pain points you shared:
- Latency-sensitive chat assistants for customer support (95th pct latency target ~ <200ms for short queries).
- Hybrid on-prem + cloud requirement for PII workflows (want private deployment for sensitive data).
- Need structured outputs and reliable function-calling to map user intent -> backend actions (order lookups, ticket creation).
- Embedding-based similarity search and reranking for knowledge base results; quality matters more than raw throughput for search reranking.

How Redwood maps to those needs (fit notes):
- Serving + latency: our Dedicated tier can meet 95th pct SLAs with optimized kernels and streaming; we recommend an initial config with 2x reserved endpoints for your 50 qps baseline to headroom bursts.
- Private deployment: we support VPC/private control plane and an on-prem option for the PII path — Vivek will follow up with the deployment checklist.
- Function calling / structured outputs: Redwood SDK supports structured JSON outputs and explicit function-calling patterns. On the call we discussed the SDK change required: use the new /chat/stream endpoint with function metadata (see stub in attachment) so the model returns deterministic JSON for downstream systems.
- Streaming + SDK: streaming responses are supported in our SDKs (Python/TS). For your UI we recommend streaming token-by-token and using our response-finalize hook to persist KV cache for short-session reuse.
- Embeddings & reranking: we suggest embedding + reranker flow: produce candidate set from FAISS, score with our reranker model (we can host a small re-ranker near your data). We'll provide a sample eval harness to compare precision@5 vs current system.

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood: send technical integration notes + sample SDK code and function-calling example (attached: Redwood-Integration-Notes.pdf, acme-integration-mockup.json) — action: Marissa (sent).
2) Acme: share sample KB (anonymized) and a representative query set for reranking evaluation — action: Priya / Alex (by next Tue 4/13).
3) Redwood infra/solution: prepare Private deployment checklist and proposed Dedicated sizing w/ cost estimate — action: Vivek (ETA 4/12).
4) Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra and platform engineers to walk through SSO/KMS and on-prem networking — propose Thu 4/15 or Fri 4/16.

Open questions captured:
- Which data path must remain on-prem vs cloud (we flagged ticketing PII as likely on-prem).
- Which auth model for end-users (SSO vs API keys) — we can support both; need your security team's preference for KMS/HSM.

Thanks again — attaching the integration notes and a small mockup showing the function-calling schema we discussed. If this all looks good I can get the technical deep-dive on the calendar.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- Redwood-Integration-Notes.pdf (application/pdf) — includes SDK snippets, streaming example, function-calling schema
- acme-integration-mockup.json (application/json) — sketch of payloads and reranker scoring fields
